text_block_list.text:
—One day. While Tokai Teio and Nice Nature 
were eating in the cafeteria...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah, Twin Turbo. What's the rush?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"I came to throw down the gauntlet! From 
now on, it's Turbo's era!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Teio! I'm gonna beat you in the Derby! 
Turbo's been practicing super hard, after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, were you even able to run in the 
Derby...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who's most surprised here, 
honestly!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Still... you're right. Come to think of 
it, Turbo can just enter normally, huh?

You meet the conditions. It is true you 
can enter the starting gate, but—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. Is today's race really gonna 
be that tough?

Given her aptitudes, the Japanese Derby 
was a race that simply didn't suit Twin 
Turbo in the slightest.

With such a long final stretch, it can 
come down to a battle of finishing kicks. 
Given my running style, that's going to be 
really tough...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Still, Trainer! Turbo's gonna do it! I 
came all the way here, after all!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo's gonna leave proof of her existence 
carved right here into Tokyo!
choice_data_list: You're right, let's make it a souvenir!
Yeah, let's make it a souvenir!

text_block_list.text:
Even if I can't win, there's still 
something I can do. I'll show everyone 
that Twin Turbo is the Umamusume who can 
burn brighter and go more all-out than 
anyone in this generation!
